classes.name: TopTools
classes.summary:
The {@link TopTools | `TopTools`} package provides utilities for the topological data structure.
- ShapeMapHasher. Hash a Shape base on the TShape and the Location. The Orientation is not used.
- OrientedShapeMapHasher. Hash a Shape base on the TShape ,the Location and the Orientation.
- Instantiations of {@link TCollection | `TCollection`} for Shapes : MapOfShape IndexedMapOfShape DataMapOfIntegerShape DataMapOfShapeInteger DataMapOfShapeReal Array1OfShape HArray1OfShape SequenceOfShape HSequenceOfShape ListOfShape Array1OfListShape HArray1OfListShape DataMapOfIntegerListOfShape DataMapOfShapeListOfShape DataMapOfShapeListOfInteger IndexedDataMapOfShapeShape IndexedDataMapOfShapeListOfShape DataMapOfShapeShape IndexedMapOfOrientedShape DataMapOfShapeSequenceOfShape IndexedDataMapOfShapeAddress DataMapOfOrientedShapeShape
- LocationSet: to write sets of locations.
- ShapeSet: to writes sets of TShapes.
Package Methods:
Dump: To dump the topology of a Shape.

staticMethods.comment: This is to bypass an extraction bug. It will force the inclusion of int.hxx itself including `Standard_OStream.hxx` at the correct position.

classes.name: TopTools_LocationSet
classes.summary:
The class LocationSet stores a set of location in a relocatable state.
It can be created from Locations.
It can create Locations.
It can be write and read from a stream.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Returns an empty set of locations.

instanceMethods.name: Clear
instanceMethods.comment: Clears the content of the set.

instanceMethods.name: Add
instanceMethods.comment: Incorporate a new Location in the set and returns its index.

classes.name: TopTools_ShapeMapHasher
classes.summary: Hash tool, used for generating maps of shapes in topology.

classes.name: TopTools_ShapeSet
classes.summary:
A ShapeSets contains a Shape and all its sub-shapes and locations. It can be dump, write and read.
Methods to handle the geometry can be redefined.

instanceMethods.name: Clear
instanceMethods.comment: Clears the content of the set. This method can be redefined.

instanceMethods.name: Add
instanceMethods.comment: Stores and its sub-shape. Returns the index of . The method AddGeometry is called on each sub-shape.

instanceMethods.name: DumpExtent
instanceMethods.comment:
Dumps the number of objects in me on the stream <OS>. (Number of shapes of each type).
@param S Mutated in place; read the updated value from this argument after the call.

instanceMethods.name: AddShapes
instanceMethods.comment:
Inserts the shape <S2> in the shape <S1>. This method must be redefined to use the correct builder.
@param S1 Mutated in place; read the updated value from this argument after the call.

instanceMethods.name: Check
instanceMethods.comment:
This method is called after each new completed shape. <T> is the type. is the shape. In this class it does nothing, but it gives the opportunity in derived classes to perform extra treatment on shapes.
@param S Mutated in place; read the updated value from this argument after the call.

instanceMethods.comment: Returns number of shapes read from file.
